blocks.text: OMITTA 2026 Upgraded Wireless HDMI Transmitter and Receiver,4k Decode 1080P Output Wireless HDMI Extender Kit Plug & Play Portable 2.4g/5g, for PC/Camera/HDTV/TV Box

items.label: Plug & Play with Near-Zero Latency
items.value: Say goodbye to complicated setup. True plug-and-play wireless HDMI transmitter and receiver, no WiFi, no app and no Bluetooth needed. Connect in under 10 seconds. Latency is less than 0.01s for smooth, synchronized video. Ideal for office presentations or home entertainment – keep your workspace clean and cable‑free.

items.label: 2.4G/5G Dual Band & Long Range
items.value: Wireless HDMI transmission range up to 100 feet. Signal can go through walls or ceilings. Dual‑band 2.4G + 5G chip plus Dynamic Stability Equalizer Engine ensures strong anti‑interference performance and stable signal in various environments. Enjoy flexible, long‑distance use without restrictions.

items.label: Wide Compatibility
items.value: Broad compatibility with HDMI‑output devices: PC, laptop, camera, DV, TV box – connect to projector, monitor, or HDTV. This 2026 Upgraded wireless hdmi transmitter and receiver supports extended display modes, easily switchable. Perfect for home theater, business reports, teaching, and more. (Note: does not support smartphones or iPads.)

items.label: Metal Housing & LED Display
items.value: All‑metal housing for durability and a premium look. Compact and lightweight, easy to carry. Built‑in LED digital display shows real‑time connection status and signal strength – simplifies troubleshooting. One‑click disconnect/reconnect. Comes with HDMI adapters, Type‑C cables, extension cable.

items.label: 4K Decoding & High‑Definition Output
items.value: Supports 4K decoding and 1080P Full HD output, smooth visuals. Integrated LDS antenna enables high‑speed wireless transmission. Ideal for gaming, meetings, or home theater – enjoy immersive, high‑quality images on a large screen without cable clutter.
